ordering_rule: Sort each JSON-stat category.index by its numeric value. Exclude the explicit final-use codes from ind_use and the explicit accounting-item codes from ind_ava; require the resulting ordered code-label industry lists to agree. Economies are ordered c_orig categories excluding DOM and must equal ordered sales c_dest categories. Never use incidental object order or a first-64 slice.
